_comment: Zone and Ward pick-lists for Module A. These are PLACEHOLDER values (see Section 7 open items). Replace the `zones` and `wards` arrays with the real MCA lists once supplied — no code changes are needed; the app loads this file at startup. Each entry: { code, label }. `code` is written into exports and used as the zone prefix in the respondent ID; keep it short and stable. Optionally scope wards to a zone with a `zone` property (e.g. { code, label, zone: 'z01' }); wards without a `zone` show for every zone.
